name: Codex skill progressive-disclosure routing
decision: Repeated KRN execution workflows should live in narrow repo-local Codex skills that load targeted instructions and query retained brain knowledge when relevant, instead of expanding root prompts, root plans, or AGENTS.md.
falsifier: A repeated KRN workflow still requires copying long prompt blocks into chat, root plans, or AGENTS.md, or a relevant skill cannot query retained brain knowledge before implementation.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove automatic skill selection, that many skills are useful by default, that Codex will always load the right skill, or product readiness.
